[[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], [[Lieutenant governor/Legends|Lieutenant governor]] of [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]], owned a '''mansion''' in the [[Planet/Legends|world's]] [[Eriadu City/Legends|Eriadu City]]<ref name="CoD" /> in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' to [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]].</ref> The mansion's compound overlooked the artificial [[Water/Legends|waters]] of a nearby bay. It contained large domed enclosures, gilded columns, polished stone floors, high-ceilinged rooms, and stately colonnades. [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] found it to be impersonal and an ostentatious blend of [[Core Classic]] and [[Mid Rim Ornate]]. Valorum and the rest of his [[Coruscant delegation]] stayed at the mansion during the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]].<ref name="CoD" />

Tarkin relocated to the [[Eriadu Governor's Palace]] after becoming [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]].
